architectureItems.title: One container per customer
architectureItems.description: Every paying customer gets an isolated Docker container — your own Hermes agent, your Telegram bot, your API keys. No shared multi-tenant runtime.

architectureItems.title: Brand voice from day one
architectureItems.description: Your setup wizard compiles SOUL.md (tone & persona) and AGENTS.md (store facts) so the operator knows your business before the first command.

architectureItems.description: HiggsField for premium statics and video when connected. OpenAI fallback is confirm-gated in Telegram — Frydai never switches vendors without asking.

integrations.trustTitle: Your tools. Your data. Your control.

trustItems.title: Secure connections
trustItems.description: OAuth where supported, API keys stored encrypted. Telegram and OpenAI keys are required — we never see your store passwords.

trustItems.title: Approval before action
trustItems.description: Budget changes, ad edits, and store updates wait for your explicit approval before going live.

trustItems.title: Per-tool permissions
trustItems.description: Connect only what you need. Each integration has granular scopes — Frydai only accesses what you authorize.

trustItems.title: Your data stays yours
trustItems.description: Your store data and chat context are never used to train external models. Disconnect any integration with one click.
